item.text: {"summary":"The current `FloorToUnit` implementation in `absl/time/time.cc` always returns the truncated quotient, matching the negative fractional conversion failures. The separate `ToUnixSeconds` failure near `int64_t` minimum needs the seconds conversion implementation and its overflow behavior before a complete repair can be identified.","hypotheses":["`FloorToUnit` drops the negative-remainder adjustment, so coarse conversions truncate toward zero instead of flooring.","`ToInt64Seconds` or its underlying division path mishandles values just below the minimum representable whole-second count."],"queries":["ToInt64Seconds(Duration","IDivDuration(","ToInt64Seconds(","FloorToUnit("],"reads":[{"path":"absl/time/time.h","line":600,"symbol":"ToInt64Seconds"},{"path":"absl/time/duration.cc","line":0,"symbol":"IDivDuration"},{"path":"absl/time/duration.cc","line":0,"symbol":"ToInt64Seconds"},{"path":"absl/time/time.cc","line":50,"symbol":"FloorToUnit"}],"ready":false}
